scope: All 56 strict entity names coded Recommendation=true in the 12 selected Stage 1 answers. Original names, C/M/R decisions and totals are unchanged.
unit: Unique strict recommended entity, or entity-by-answer recommendation record as labeled; one strict name receives one mutually exclusive supplemental category.

categories.label: Research / study
categories.definition: A specific paper, study, research series or researcher normalized to that cited work.

categories.label: Individual creator
categories.definition: An explicitly named practitioner and their associated personal publishing brand, as grouped in the original coding. Does not establish employment status or independence.

categories.label: Creator + organization
categories.definition: Original coding joins an individual with a training or publishing organization; neither component is split into a new entity.

categories.label: Organization / publisher
categories.definition: Agency, company, university, training organization or publishing brand. This broad category does not establish expertise, original evidence or commercial neutrality.

categories.label: Community / discussion platform
categories.definition: A named community or community-hosting platform, not one identified individual creator.

categories.label: Resource / learning directory
categories.definition: A named repository, resource directory or multi-author course marketplace whose recommendation is treated as one resource.

categories.label: Tool
categories.definition: A specifically named measurement or webmaster tool, rather than the vendor as a publisher.

limitations: Types describe what kind of entity was recommended; they do not rate relevance, expertise, evidence quality or GEO success.
Classification is an assistant judgment based on the original names, types and recommendation context. Most entities were not independently source-checked.
Original entity normalization is retained, including combined person/brand entities. Categories do not infer that every named practitioner is an independent builder.
Unique counts are deduplicated within the stated scope. Entity-by-answer records count repeat appearances. Neither is a quality score or a population recommendation rate.
